rollout_phases.name: Membership model, controlled roles, and status
rollout_phases.objective: Additive active/approved membership semantics without deleting legacy rows.
rollout_phases.compatibility: read legacy records but treat no new membership as active until approved transition completes.
rollout_phases.success: no browser path can create an active privileged membership.

steps: restore prior policy set from approved release

rollout_phases.name: Invitation and approval workflow
rollout_phases.objective: Bind invitation to vendor, role, email/account, expiry, single use, approver, and audit event.
risks: existing invite links lack required metadata
rollout_phases.compatibility: legacy invitations remain non-authoritative and require reissue.
rollout_phases.success: only accepted valid invite or authorized admin creates membership.

rollout_phases.name: Role-aware authorization helpers
rollout_phases.objective: Replace manages_vendor with active role, brand, region, capability, and expiry-aware checks.
rollout_phases.compatibility: introduce parallel helper telemetry before policy cutover.

steps: revert policy callers to approved compatibility helper

rollout_phases.name: RLS replacement
rollout_phases.objective: Retire self-role, self-join, role-blind, and organization-only manufacturer write paths.
rollout_phases.compatibility: stage in preview with policy simulation and platform-admin recovery.
rollout_phases.success: all manufacturer writes require active scoped permission.

rollback.verification: portal loads and legacy legitimate access restored

rollout_phases.name: Storage hardening
rollout_phases.objective: Private vendor-assets, verified vendor/asset path, signed reads, scan/quarantine, and retryable deletion.
rollout_phases.compatibility: inventory URLs; signed-URL adapter and dual-read window before bucket visibility change.
rollout_phases.success: no direct public vendor draft access or unscoped upload.

steps: do not reopen broad public upload

rollout_phases.name: Portal compatibility
rollout_phases.objective: Replace direct browser role/member/invite writes with approved flows and permission-aware UI.
rollout_phases.compatibility: feature flag by portal capability; clear unsupported-client error.
rollout_phases.success: browser is never the authority boundary.

rollout_phases.name: Controlling manufacturer entity creation
rollout_phases.objective: Create only human-approved controller entities from Priority 5B.
risks: wrong legal entity or portfolio scope
rollout_phases.success: each controller has approved identity and region scope.

steps: remove no assignments because activation has not begun
rollback.verification: no brand points to disputed entity

rollout_phases.name: Brand ownership activation
rollout_phases.objective: Apply approved brand_catalog manufacturer assignments only after authorization gates pass.
rollout_phases.compatibility: staging backfill, report-only ownership checks, phased brand cohorts.
rollout_phases.success: every activated brand has approved controller and region rule.

rollout_phases.name: Manufacturer onboarding and monitoring
rollout_phases.objective: Onboard users through approved invitations and continuously monitor audit events.
rollout_phases.compatibility: pilot one controller and brand cohort before scale.
rollout_phases.success: onboarding has no direct role/membership writes and alerts on overrides.

future.migration: additive fields and scope records; preserve historical memberships; never auto-activate legacy records

role_model.inheritance: none implicit; permissions are explicit and scope-intersected
role_model.prohibitions: no role grants platform admin; editors cannot invite/publish outside permission; viewer is read-only
role_model.audit: role, scope, approval, expiry, suspension, override

helper_transition.compatibility: parallel evaluation and telemetry, then RLS caller cutover; do not retain permissive fallback in production
helper_transition.rollback: restore prior approved helper callers only while ownership activation remains disabled

rls_plan.retire: direct browser privileged mutations after compatibility verification
rls_plan.rule: USING and WITH CHECK require active scoped permission

portal_compatibility.manufacturer: feature-flag approved invitation, scope display, signed URLs, server-side asset deletion
portal_compatibility.trade: published/signed read only; no role upsert
portal_compatibility.api_edge: privileged server actions only; no service key in browser
portal_compatibility.window: dual-read compatibility only; never dual-write privileged browser flow

deployment_gates.evidence: role/RLS/storage matrix and approved entity evidence
deployment_gates.validation: no automatic membership or brand assignment

deployment_gates.evidence: brand/controller/region approval; Hotpoint and Insignia decisions
deployment_gates.validation: cohort cross-brand and regional tests pass

deployment_gates.evidence: pilot support runbook, audit monitoring, invitation tests
deployment_gates.approval_owner: platform operations plus manufacturer program owner
deployment_gates.validation: pilot onboarding and rollback drill pass

unresolved_decisions: legal operating representative for each new controller
